text.text_excerpt: The location is fantastic. Just far enough removed from the mess of Bourbon Street, but still close enough for you party people. Pretty much everything is within walking distance - even the conference center on the river front is only a 20 minute walk away. I enjoyed my stay here, and really appreciated the fact that they let me check-in at 8AM on the morning of my arrival even though check-in time is typically not until 4PM. I also loved the room that I was given (a corner room on one of the newly added floors). It was spacious and the bed was so, so comfortable. It was like sleeping on clouds, I kid you not. The only thing that kind of irked me was the separate elevator that was needed ...

I've stayed here a couple times now. I enjoy the friendly staff and the security at night (no one gets in the elevators without showing key card, even though a key card is needed to go up the elevator). I had gotten in on an early flight so they held my luggage while I went to eat and they would call when the room was ready. They called before I even received my food, which was awesome. The hotel is situated close to everything - bourbon street, restaurants and bars, casino, convention center, trolley. The rooms are large, with a sitting room and a separate bedroom. I also love they give you two water bottles in the room. I recommend this place and I will be back here again next time I come.

This place is PERFECT for your stay here in New Orleans. Literally in walking distance from everywhere we wanted to go. We never once had to take an Uber unless it was back to the airport. The entire staff working at this place was super nice and willing to help you whenever needed. They always had a positive attitude and a smile on their face. Rooms were very clean and at night it's quiet. You don't hear all the partying going on. I don't know why or how people could not have given this place better reviews. Our experience here was great. This is the place I'll be staying at again the next time I come.
